title: Collections Timeline for Past Due Pocketwire Pay in 4 Accounts
content:
A Pocketwire Pay in 4 account that is past due follows the collections timeline below, every period counted in calendar days from the date the account became past due, as recorded on the account.

### Timeline by tier

| Tier | Suspended once past due for (calendar days) | Unpaid plans written off once past due for (calendar days) | Wait after a suspended account is repaid in full before reinstatement (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | 14 | 120 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 14 | 120 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 21 | 120 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 21 | 120 | 30 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 30 | 120 | 14 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 30 | 120 | 14 |

The periods apply according to the tier the account is on.

### Clauses

**1. Return to active.** A past due account returns to active once no installment is past its grace days unpaid, that is, once every overdue installment is paid.

**2. Suspension.** A past due account is suspended after the tier's suspension period of calendar days past due, counted from the date it became past due.

**3. Write-off.** A past due account has its unpaid plans written off after 120 calendar days, counted the same way. Each write-off is recorded against its plan with the write-off date and the amount written off, which comes off what the customer owes on Pocketwire Pay in 4.

**4. Reinstatement.** A suspended account repaid in full is reinstated on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter after the tier's waiting period of calendar days, counted from the day it was repaid in full, whatever tier it held before; a suspended account with a write-off is closed instead.

**5. Closing by the customer.** The customer can close an active account only when nothing is owed; closing is the customer's own decision.

### Status changes and who makes them

| From | To | Made by | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | past due | the system | an installment is still unpaid after its grace days |
| past due | active | a representative | every overdue installment is paid |
| past due | suspended | a representative | the account stayed past due for the suspension period |
| suspended | active | a representative | a suspended account repaid in full, after the waiting period, on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter |
| suspended | closed | a representative | after repayment or write-off, with the closing date recorded |
| active | closed | the customer | nothing is owed, with the closing date recorded |

### Day counts (hypothetical account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic, past due since day 0 and still past due)

| Day | Position |
|---|---|
| Day 13 | Past due; the 14 calendar days have not yet passed |
| Day 14 | 14 calendar days past due reached; suspended |
| Day 119 | Suspended; no write-off yet |
| Day 120 | 120 calendar days reached; unpaid plans written off, and the account is then closed |

If instead the customer repays the Classic account in full while it is suspended, on day 40, reinstatement on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter falls on day 70, after the 30-day wait. An account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier in the same position would wait 14 days.

### Basis Q&A

**Can a customer close an account while an installment is still owed?**
No. An active account can be closed only when nothing is owed, and the decision to close is the customer's own.
